item.description:
### Added
- DeepSnap Help › Capturing shows the magnifier at work, in a GIF. - Buy Pro on the last step of onboarding, beside the free week. - Welcome to DeepSnap in the menu bar menu brings the onboarding back.
### Changed
- The menu bar menu says just Help, About and Quit. - Onboarding comes back at the next launch if it was closed before the end — unless Don’t show again is checked.
### Fixed
- Keys pressed asks for Accessibility when you turn it on — in Settings › Recording or on the recording card — not once the recording has started; Settings says so until it is allowed. - Launch at Login that macOS holds for approval opens Login Items, and the menu shows a dash until it is approved. - Open System Settings goes straight to Screen & System Audio Recording on macOS 26, without restarting System Settings first. - Turned Screen Recording on? Check Again sees it right away; if macOS still wants a restart, Restart DeepSnap is there.
